name: RDM Refurbished!
summary:
Immerse in the vast possibilities of RDM Refurbished! Stemming from the original designs of the game, RDM Refurbished focuses on core memories from the 2022-23 builds of Rainin' Drainin' Monkes!

Explore and branch your way around the Forest, climb the unrelenting summits of Peaks, view the Forest from High Meadows, experiment with cosmetics in the Store and so, so much more!
